title: Network Latency Spike — ml-inference-service
description: Injects 800ms additional latency on ml-inference-service container network interface using tc netem. Validates that forecast-service circuit breaker opens, fallback activates, and P99 latency alert fires on Prometheus.

arguments: P99=$(curl -sf '${prometheus_url}/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.99,rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="ml-inference-service"}[5m]))' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); r=d['data']['result']; print(float(r[0]['value'][1]) if r else 0)"); echo "ML P99: ${P99}s"; [ $(echo "$P99 < 0.5" | bc -l) -eq 1 ]

CONTAINER_PID=$(docker inspect --format='{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -qf name=${target_service})); nsenter -t $CONTAINER_PID -n tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem delay ${latency_ms}ms ${jitter_ms}ms distribution normal && echo "[CHAOS] Injected ${latency_ms}ms ± ${jitter_ms}ms latency on ${target_service} eth0"

for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:8083/api/forecasts -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"productId":"chaos-'$i'","horizon":7}' & done; wait; echo '[CHAOS] 50 concurrent forecast requests fired'

ALERT=$(curl -sf '${prometheus_url}/api/v1/alerts' | python3 -c "import sys,json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); alerts=[a for a in data['data']['alerts'] if 'Latency' in a['labels'].get('alertname','')]; print(len(alerts))"); echo "[CHAOS] Active latency alerts: $ALERT"; [ "$ALERT" -gt 0 ]

CONTAINER_PID=$(docker inspect --format='{{.State.Pid}}' $(docker ps -qf name=${target_service})); nsenter -t $CONTAINER_PID -n tc qdisc del dev eth0 root 2>/dev/null || true; echo '[CHAOS ROLLBACK] Latency injection removed'
